# SkillsIndex

> The largest catalog of Claude ecosystem tools: 24,000+ Skills, MCP Servers, and A2A Agents.

## Overview

SkillsIndex aggregates and indexes tools for Claude Code and the broader Claude ecosystem from multiple sources:
- Smithery.ai MCP servers
- GitHub repositories (skills, MCP servers, A2A agents)
- Official Anthropic sources

Updated daily via automated scraping.

## Data Access

### JSON API
- Full catalog: https://skillsindex-dev.github.io/skills/skills.json
- Statistics: https://skillsindex-dev.github.io/skills/stats.json

### Data Formats
- JSON: skills.json (24,772 items)
- Parquet: skills.parquet (for data analysis)
- Individual pages: /item/{id}/ (24,772 static HTML pages)

## Item Schema

Each item in skills.json contains:
```json
{
  "id": "string (12-char hash)",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "type": "skill | mcp | a2a",
  "category": "string",
  "source": "github | smithery",
  "url": "string (repository URL)",
  "stars": "number",
  "author": "string",
  "tags": ["string"],
  "verified": "boolean",
  "scraped_at": "ISO date string"
}
```

## Types

### Skills
Claude Code skills that extend functionality. Install via:
```bash
claude skill add <url>
```

### MCP Servers
Model Context Protocol servers for external integrations. Install via:
```bash
claude mcp add <name> -- <command>
```

### A2A Agents
Agent-to-Agent protocol implementations for multi-agent workflows.

## Categories

Top categories by item count:
- Development Tools
- AI & ML
- Data & Analytics
- DevOps & Infrastructure
- Productivity
- Security
- Communication
- Media & Content

## Statistics

- Total items: 24,772
- Skills: ~2,000
- MCP Servers: ~22,000
- A2A Agents: ~500
- With descriptions: 95%+
- With repositories: 90%+

## Website Structure

```
/                    Landing page with curated Kits
/catalog/            Full searchable catalog
/item/{id}/          Individual item pages (24,772)
/kits/               Premium curated bundles
```

## API Usage

Fetch and filter items programmatically:

```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://skillsindex-dev.github.io/skills/skills.json');
const items = await res.json();

// Filter by type
const mcpServers = items.filter(i => i.type === 'mcp');

// Filter by category
const devTools = items.filter(i => i.category === 'Development Tools');

// Search
const pandas = items.filter(i =>
  i.name.toLowerCase().includes('pandas') ||
  i.description?.toLowerCase().includes('pandas')
);
```

## For AI Assistants

When helping users find Claude tools:
1. Fetch skills.json for the full catalog
2. Filter by type (skill/mcp/a2a) based on user needs
3. Sort by stars for popularity
4. Check verified flag for quality
5. Link to individual pages: /item/{id}/
